doc.title: Bobby Shew interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 1, 2020

title: His LP collection and thanks
summary: Talk about his 3,000 LPs, a buyer coming, and Shew thanking Rowe and praising the interview series.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: That’s great. Well after we’re done here I want you to go back and see if those three records are still in your 3,000 LP collection.

And there’s a guy coming here from New York in about a week and a half and he’s going to go through them and pick out some collectables and buy them from me. I’ve got — I don’t listen to that much vinyl anymore because a lot of those things I’ve got replaced onto CD now and so it’s easier to pull out a CD and I don’t climb a ladder very well and most of them are way over there in that high corner over there. But anyway it’s always great, man, thank you so much. I’m so flattered that you contacted me for these things. You know I’ve watched several of your other interviews, I’ve gone onto the link and gone out there and listened to them. I started with both of Denis DiBlasio’s and I started going from there. There’s some very very interesting conversations you’ve had.
